proof_0505.moves: Given the tower R -> S -> T with S algebraic over R and T integral over S, unpack the IsIntegral class to pointwise integrality and feed it to the transitivity lemma IsIntegral.trans_isAlgebraic, then repackage the pointwise conclusion with the IsAlgebraic constructor.

proof_0506.moves: Pure definitional monotonicity: a vertex cover condition says every edge meets the set, so enlarging the set along s <= t preserves it; the real work is a one-line membership chase hidden in an auto-generated private obligation.

proof_0507.moves: An auto-generated obligation for the equivalence G/ker f = range f: it is exactly the pairing of injectivity and surjectivity of rangeKerLift into a bijectivity conjunction.

proof_0508.moves: Apply the general transport lemma for vadd-invariant measures to the constant-vadd map: measurability of const-vadd supplies the pushforward, and the commuting-actions hypothesis supplies the required equivariance.

proof_0509.moves: Primed variant of a monotonicity lemma for convergence to bottom: upgrade the everywhere-pointwise bound g <= f to an eventual bound with Eventually.of_forall, then invoke the unprimed lemma.

proof_0510.moves: This is the machine-generated reassociated form of lift_snd_comp_fst_comp: whisker the base equation on the right and reassociate composition. No new mathematics beyond associativity plus the base lemma.

proof_0511.moves: Machine-generated reassociated form of comp2_iso_inv in the pith of a bicategory: right-whisker the base equation and reassociate. The only mathematical input is the base lemma.

proof_0512.moves: Push the inversion through the filter pushforward using map_inv' (valid since the map is a monoid hom), then apply antitone/monotone behaviour of inversion on filters to the Tendsto hypothesis; an equality-then-inequality step glues the two.

proof_0513.moves: The cast of 1 from the nonnegative rationals to the rationals is 1 by definition: the whole proof is rfl, the content being that the NNRat semiring one and the coercion agree definitionally.

proof_0514.moves: Definitional: skip? on a string position is literally implemented by the slice version, so both sides reduce to the same term and rfl closes it.

proof_0515.moves: Unfold ENNReal.ofReal as the coercion of Real.toNNReal, cancel the coercion with coe_le_coe, and reduce to the corresponding order iff for toNNReal on the reals.

proof_0516.moves: Membership in the support is characterised via the cycleOf permutation: x in support iff x is in the same cycle and not fixed; the SameCycle hypothesis transfers this to y, using symmetry of SameCycle for the reverse direction, and the two implications are packed into an iff.

proof_0517.moves: Definitional unfolding of the Finset applicative instance: seqRight is by construction the stated expression, so rfl closes it.

proof_0518.moves: Transport the tree-map lemma across the extensional quotient: induct on a representative with inductionOn, then apply the DTreeMap lemma, keeping the dependent cast along the key-comparison equality.

proof_0519.moves: A definitional projection lemma: the action on morphisms of the condensed-set-to-TopCat functor is by construction the underlying toTopCat map, so the proof is rfl.

proof_0520.moves: Specialise the universe-lifted relrank statement to a single universe and cancel the Cardinal.lift with lift_id; the mathematical content is entirely in the lifted lemma.

proof_0521.moves: Rewrite Option.bind as a case analysis on the option, apply computability of option case-analysis with the constant none function on the none branch, and fix the resulting function up to pointwise equality with Computable.of_eq.

proof_0522.moves: The integer scalar action on continuous maps is defined pointwise, so applying the scaled map at a point is definitionally the scaled value; rfl.

proof_0523.moves: Pointwise reduction: to show the composite is analytic on the set, fix a point of the set, use MapsTo to land the image in the target set, and apply the within-at composition lemma there.

proof_0524.moves: Rewrite the right-derivability-structure hypothesis through its characterising iff and read off the Guitart exactness of the associated square; a single propositional transport.

proof_0525.moves: Exhibit the subsemigroup inclusion as an additive hom that is topologically inducing (the subtype topology is the induced topology, by rfl), then transport separate continuity of addition along it.

proof_0526.moves: Specialise the eval2 version of sum-commutation to the identity ring hom, since eval is by definition eval2 along the identity.

proof_0527.moves: Build the lawfulness instance for a single-character backward pattern by discharging the two required equations (endsWith and skipSuffixOfNonempty?), each reducing to the character-predicate pattern with the predicate being equality to the given character.

proof_0528.moves: Congruence transfer: if two arithmetic functions agree on all nonzero naturals then their L-series summability and L-series values agree, so the HasSum statements are equivalent; assembled by simp from the summability and value congruence lemmas.
